title: SDS-PAGE Protocol
author: Anna Behle
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8evhte6
materials: Prepare your protein solutions by incubating them with 5x Protein loading dye containing SDS for 30 minutes at 50°C to denature the proteins. They can be stored on ice until putting them on the gel or used directly. Use about 20 µg of protein if you intend to dye the gel with 9 Coomassie blue. Use about 3 µg for a western blot.
Pipette your denatured protein solutions into the pockets.

steps.title: Prepare Gel Components
steps.instruction: Mix all components for the running and collection gels except for APS and TEMED. Ensure Urea is completely dissolved by stirring at 150 rpm for approximately 15 minutes. Use gel buffer with bromphenole blue dye to increase visibility of collection gel pockets.

substeps.instruction: Running gel: 4.8 g Urea, 2.9 ml Acrylamid, 4.7 ml Gel buffer, 3.8 ml H2O
Collection gel: 0.7 ml Acrylamid, 1.53 ml Gel buffer, 4 ml H2O

steps.title: Cast Stop Gel
steps.instruction: Create a quickly-polymerizing stop gel to prevent the running gel from leaking.

substeps.instruction: Mix 1 ml of running gel (without APS and TEMED) with 2 µl TEMED and 20 µl APS.
Quickly pipette the mixture into the gel chamber until the bottom is filled evenly.

steps.title: Cast Running Gel
steps.instruction: Polymerize the running gel in the chamber.

substeps.instruction: Add 88 µl APS and 10 µl TEMED to the running gel and mix by inverting the tube.
Pipette approximately 5 ml into the gel chamber.
Pipette approximately 500 µl of Isopropanol on top of the running gel to exclude air.

steps.title: Prepare Gel Surface
steps.instruction: Remove isopropanol once the running gel is fully polymerized by pouring it out and drying the corners with absorbent paper.

steps.title: Cast Collection Gel
steps.instruction: Polymerize the collection gel and form the sample pockets.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µl APS and 10 µl TEMED to the collection gel.
Pipette the mixture on top of the running gel until the chamber is filled.
Quickly insert the gel comb to the desired depth.
Allow the gel to polymerize fully.
Place the SDS gel into the appropriate chamber.
Fill the middle of the chamber with cathode buffer and the bottom with anode buffer.
Gently pull the comb out of the gel.
Use a pipette or needle to straighten the pockets and flush them with buffer.

steps.title: Run Electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Run the gel at a constant 45 mA for approximately 90 minutes.

steps.title: Fix the Gel
steps.instruction: Fix the proteins in the gel after electrophoresis.

substeps.instruction: Remove the gel and glass from the chamber and place into a small tub.
Add fixation solution and incubate at 150 rpm for 5 minutes.
Recycle the fixation solution.

steps.title: Stain the Gel
steps.instruction: Stain the gel using Coomassie Blue.

substeps.instruction: Add Coomassie Blue Dyeing solution and incubate at 150 rpm for 5-10 minutes.
Recycle the Coomassie Blue solution.

steps.title: Destain and Final Fixation
steps.instruction: Perform final fixation and rehydration of the gel.

substeps.instruction: Add fixation solution and incubate at 150 rpm for several hours or overnight.
Pour the solution into the Coomassie Blue trash.
Add water to return the gel to its original size and incubate for at least 10 minutes.

steps.title: Image Gel
steps.instruction: Image the gel using a GelDoc system.
